## Quarto

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
SimBA_sum <- read_excel(
  "Sum_0506.xlsx",
  sheet = "SimBA Summary"
)

Boris_sum <- read_excel(
  "Sum_0506.xlsx",
  sheet = "Boris Summary"
)
```

```{r}
isolation_list = c("17_59_14", "18_17_10", "18_37_02", "18_55_10", "20_48_07", "21_05_10")
sum_bouts = read_excel("sum_full.xlsx")
boris_bouts = read_excel("boris_full.xlsx")
sum_social = sum_bouts |>
  filter(behavior == "approach_social" | behavior == "nonapproach_social") |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)
sum_freeze = sum_bouts |>
  filter(behavior == "approach_freeze" | behavior == "nonapproach_freeze") |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)
social_isolation = sum_social |>
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)
social_grouped = sum_social |>
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)
freeze_isolation = sum_freeze |>
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)
freeze_grouped = sum_freeze |>
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)
```

```{r}
breaks <- c(0, 1, 5, 15, Inf)
labels <- c("0-1", "1-5", "5-15","15+")

plot_social <- bind_rows(
  social_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  social_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      labels = labels,
      right = FALSE
    )
  )
ggplot(plot_social, aes(x = bout_bin, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "SimBA Social Bout Time Distribution",
    x = "Bout duration (s)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_freeze <- bind_rows(
  freeze_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  freeze_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      labels = labels,
      right = FALSE
    )
  )
ggplot(plot_freeze, aes(x = bout_bin, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "SimBA Freeze Bout Time Distribution",
    x = "Bout duration (s)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins of 0.1 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

breaks <- c(seq(0, 15, by = 0.1), Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SimBA Social: Combining Approach Social and Being Approached Social
# ------------------------------------------------------------

simba_social <- sum_bouts %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      behavior,
      regex("social", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = end_time - start_time
  )

social_isolation <- simba_social %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

social_grouped <- simba_social %>%
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_social <- bind_rows(
  social_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  social_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      right = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    bout_bin_num = as.numeric(bout_bin) * 0.1 - 0.05,
    bout_bin_plot = compress_x(bout_bin_num)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  plot_social,
  aes(x = bout_bin_plot, fill = group)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    boundary = 0,
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped" = "black",
      "Isolation" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = compress_x(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15)),
    labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "5", "10", "15")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IS10 SimBA Social Bout Duration",
    x = "Bout Duration (s)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins of 0.1 seconds

breaks <- c(seq(0, 15, by = 0.1), Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# simBA Freeze: Combining Approach Freeze and Being Approached Freeze
# ------------------------------------------------------------

simba_freeze <- sum_bouts %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      behavior,
      regex("freeze|withdraw", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = end_time - start_time
  )

freeze_isolation <- simba_freeze %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

freeze_grouped <- simba_freeze %>%
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_freeze <- bind_rows(
  freeze_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  freeze_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      right = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    bout_bin_num = as.numeric(bout_bin) * 0.1 - 0.05,
    bout_bin_plot = compress_x(bout_bin_num)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  plot_freeze,
  aes(x = bout_bin_plot, fill = group)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    boundary = 0,
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped" = "black",
      "Isolation" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = compress_x(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15)),
    labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "5", "10", "15")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IS10 SimBA Freeze Bout Duration",
    x = "Bout Duration (s)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# Keeps 0–3 seconds expanded and compresses durations above 3 s
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins
# ------------------------------------------------------------

breaks <- c(seq(0, 15, by = 0.1), Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Boris Being Approached Social
# ------------------------------------------------------------

boris_being_social <- boris_bouts %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      Behavior,
      regex("I-E-social", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = `Stop (s)` - `Start (s)`
  )

social_isolation <- boris_being_social %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

social_grouped <- boris_being_social %>%
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)

plot_social <- bind_rows(
  social_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  social_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      right = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    bout_bin_num = as.numeric(bout_bin) * 0.1 - 0.05,
    bout_bin_plot = compress_x(bout_bin_num)
  )

ggplot(
  plot_social,
  aes(x = bout_bin_plot, fill = group)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    boundary = 0,
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped" = "black",
      "Isolation" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = compress_x(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15)),
    labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "5", "10", "15")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IS10 Boris Being Approached Social Bout Duration",
    x = "Bout Duration (s)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Boris Being Approached Freeze
# ------------------------------------------------------------

boris_being_freeze <- boris_bouts %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      Behavior,
      regex("I-E-freez", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = `Stop (s)` - `Start (s)`
  )

freeze_isolation <- boris_being_freeze %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

freeze_grouped <- boris_being_freeze %>%

plot_freeze <- bind_rows(

ggplot(
```

```{r}
# Social bouts
boris_approach_social <- boris_bouts %>%
   filter(str_detect(
      Behavior,

    )) |>

  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

social_grouped <- boris_approach_social %>%
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Function to enlarge 0–3 seconds while retaining all data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

plot_social <- bind_rows(
  social_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  social_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      right = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    bout_bin_num = as.numeric(bout_bin) * 0.1 - 0.05,
    bout_bin_plot = compress_x(bout_bin_num)
  )

ggplot(
  plot_social,
  aes(x = bout_bin_plot, fill = group)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    boundary = 0,
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped" = "black",
      "Isolation" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = compress_x(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15)),
    labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "5", "10", "15")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IS10 Boris Approach Social Bout Duration",

    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +

    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
```
```{r}
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins of 0.1 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}

simba_plot <- SimBA_sum %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(Video %in% isolation_list,
                   "Isolation",
                   "Grouped")
  )

simba_summary <- simba_plot %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bouts = mean(`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bouts = sd(`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# t-test
tt <- t.test(`Approach Social bouts` ~ Group, data = simba_plot)
pval <- tt$p.value

sig_label <- case_when(
  pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

y_max <- max(simba_plot$`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sig <- y_max * 1.10

ggplot() +

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = simba_summary,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      ymin = mean_bouts - sd_bouts,
      ymax = mean_bouts + sd_bouts
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines
  geom_segment(
    data = simba_summary,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(factor(Group)) - 0.20,
      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `Approach Social bouts`),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Isolation"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `Approach Social bouts`),
    shape = 21,
    color = "red",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Thick significance line
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = y_sig,
    yend = y_sig,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Red stars
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = y_sig + 0.03 * y_max,
    label = sig_label,
    color = "red",
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "SimBA Approach-Social (AS)",
    x = "",
    y = "Approach-Social Bouts (#)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
)
```

```{r}
            (`Approach Social bouts` + `Approach Freeze bouts`)
  )

  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bouts = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bouts = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),

  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

y_sig <- y_max + 0.15 * diff(range(simba_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE))

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = ratio_summary,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      ymin = mean_bouts - sd_bouts,

    ),

    ),

    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points

    color = "black",
    fill = NA,

    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Isolation"),
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio),
    shape = 21,
    color = "red",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Thick significance line
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = y_sig,

    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Red significance stars
```

```{r}
    ratio = (`Approach Social bouts` - `Approach Freeze bouts`) /
            (`Approach Social bouts` + `Approach Freeze bouts`)
  )

boris_ratio <- boris_plot %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bouts = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bouts = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# t-test
tt <- t.test(ratio ~ Group, data = boris_plot)
pval <- tt$p.value

sig_label <- case_when(
  pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

y_max <- max(boris_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sig <- y_max + 0.15 * diff(range(boris_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot() +

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = boris_ratio,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      ymin = mean_bouts - sd_bouts,
      ymax = mean_bouts + sd_bouts
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines
  geom_segment(
    data = boris_ratio,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(factor(Group)) - 0.20,
      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(boris_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(boris_plot, Group == "Isolation"),
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio),
    shape = 21,
    color = "red",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Thick significance line
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = y_sig,
    yend = y_sig,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Red significance stars
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = y_sig + 0.05 * diff(range(boris_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    label = sig_label,
    color = "red",
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Boris (AS-AF)/(AS+AF) Index",
    x = "",
    y = "AS-AF Conflict Index"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
)
```

```{r}
)

  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines

    data = simba_summary,

      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `Being Approached Social bouts`),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",

    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Isolation"),

    color = "red",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(

      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Thick significance line

  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),

  axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
)
```

```{r}
SimBA_sum2 <- read_excel(
  "IS8 SimBA+BORIS Scoring Summary.xlsx",
  sheet = "SimBA Summary"
)

Boris_sum2 <- read_excel(
  "IS8 SimBA+BORIS Scoring Summary.xlsx",
```

```{r}
isolation_list = c("145022", "152402", "155457", "162555", "164224", "165812", "171420", "124537", "131813", "135058", "142313", "145501", "152506", "162207")
sum_bouts = read_excel("sum_full2.xlsx")
boris_bouts = read_excel("boris_full2.xlsx")
sum_social = sum_bouts |>
  filter(behavior == "approach_social" | behavior == "nonapproach_social") |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)
sum_freeze = sum_bouts |>
  filter(behavior == "approach_freeze" | behavior == "nonapproach_freeze") |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)

  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# Keeps 0–3 seconds expanded and compresses durations above 3 s
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins
# ------------------------------------------------------------

breaks <- c(seq(0, 15, by = 0.1), Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Boris Being Approached Social
# ------------------------------------------------------------

boris_being_social <- boris_bouts %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      Behavior,
      regex("I-E-social", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = `Stop (s)` - `Start (s)`
  )

social_isolation <- boris_being_social %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

social_grouped <- boris_being_social %>%
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)

plot_social <- bind_rows(
  social_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  social_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      right = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    bout_bin_num = as.numeric(bout_bin) * 0.1 - 0.05,
    bout_bin_plot = compress_x(bout_bin_num)
  )

ggplot(
  plot_social,
  aes(x = bout_bin_plot, fill = group)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    boundary = 0,
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped" = "black",
      "Isolation" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = compress_x(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15)),
    labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "5", "10", "15")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IS8 Boris Being Approached Social Bout Duration",
    x = "Bout Duration (s)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Boris Being Approached Freeze
# ------------------------------------------------------------

boris_being_freeze <- boris_bouts %>%
  filter(

freeze_isolation <- boris_being_freeze %>%
```

```{r}
simba_plot <- SimBA_sum2 %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(Video %in% isolation_list,
                   "Isolation",
                   "Grouped")
  )

simba_summary <- simba_plot %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bouts = mean(`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bouts = sd(`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# t-test
tt <- t.test(`Approach Social bouts` ~ Group, data = simba_plot)
pval <- tt$p.value

sig_label <- case_when(
  pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

y_max <- max(simba_plot$`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sig <- y_max * 1.10

ggplot() +

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = simba_summary,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      ymin = mean_bouts - sd_bouts,
      ymax = mean_bouts + sd_bouts
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines
  geom_segment(
    data = simba_summary,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(factor(Group)) - 0.20,
      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `Approach Social bouts`),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Isolation"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `Approach Social bouts`),
    shape = 21,
    color = "red",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Thick significance line
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = y_sig,
    yend = y_sig,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Red stars
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = y_sig + 0.03 * y_max,
    label = sig_label,
    color = "red",
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "IS8 SimBA Approach-Social (AS)",
    x = "",
    y = "Approach-Social Bouts (#)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
)
```

```{r}
# Calculate ratio once
simba_plot <- SimBA_sum2 %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(Video %in% isolation_list,
                   "Isolation",
                   "Grouped"),
    ratio = (`Approach Social bouts` - `Approach Freeze bouts`) /
            (`Approach Social bouts` + `Approach Freeze bouts`)
  )

ratio_summary <- simba_plot %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bouts = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bouts = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = ratio_summary,

      x = Group,

    ),

    ),

    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points

      height = 0,

    )

  # Red significance stars
```

```{r}
y_max <- max(simba_plot$`BA Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE)

    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines
  geom_segment(
    data = simba_summary,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(factor(Group)) - 0.20,
      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `BA Social bouts`),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Isolation"),

      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )

scale_y_continuous(
```

```{r}
simba_plot <- SimBA_sum2 %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(Video %in% isolation_list,
                   "Isolation",
                   "Grouped"),
    ratio = (`BA Social bouts` - `BA Freeze bouts`) /
            (`BA Social bouts` + `BA Freeze bouts`)
  )

ratio_summary <- simba_plot %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bouts = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bouts = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# t-test
tt <- t.test(ratio ~ Group, data = simba_plot)
pval <- tt$p.value

sig_label <- case_when(
  pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

y_max <- max(simba_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sig <- y_max + 0.15 * diff(range(simba_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot() +

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = ratio_summary,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      ymin = mean_bouts - sd_bouts,
      ymax = mean_bouts + sd_bouts
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines
  geom_segment(
    data = ratio_summary,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(factor(Group)) - 0.20,
      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Isolation"),
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio),
    shape = 21,
    color = "red",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Thick significance line
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = y_sig,
    yend = y_sig,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Red significance stars
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = y_sig + 0.05 * diff(range(simba_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    label = sig_label,
    color = "red",
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "IS8 SimBA (BAS-BAF)/(BAS+BAF) Index",
    x = "",
    y = "BAS-BAF Conflict Index"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
SimBA_sum <- read_excel(
  "Sum_0923.xlsx",
  sheet = "SimBA Summary"
)

Boris_sum <- read_excel(
  "Sum_0923.xlsx",
  sheet = "Boris Summary"
)
isolation_list = c("13_54_29", "14_10_39", "14_25_44")
sum_bouts = read_excel("sum_full2.xlsx")
boris_bouts = read_excel("boris_full2.xlsx")
sum_social = sum_bouts |>
  filter(behavior == "approach_social" | behavior == "nonapproach_social") |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)
sum_freeze = sum_bouts |>
  filter(behavior == "approach_freeze" | behavior == "nonapproach_freeze") |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)
social_isolation = sum_social |>
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)
social_grouped = sum_social |>
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)
freeze_isolation = sum_freeze |>
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)
freeze_grouped = sum_freeze |>
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins of 0.1 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

breaks <- c(seq(0, 15, by = 0.1), Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Boris Social: Combining Approach Social and Being Approached Social
# ------------------------------------------------------------

boris_social <- boris_bouts %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      Behavior,
      regex("E-I-social|I-E-social", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = `Stop (s)` - `Start (s)`
  )

social_isolation <- boris_social %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

social_grouped <- boris_social %>%
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_social <- bind_rows(
  social_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  social_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      right = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    bout_bin_num = as.numeric(bout_bin) * 0.1 - 0.05,
    bout_bin_plot = compress_x(bout_bin_num)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  plot_social,
  aes(x = bout_bin_plot, fill = group)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    boundary = 0,
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped" = "black",
      "Isolation" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = compress_x(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15)),
    labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "5", "10", "15")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IS13 Boris Social Bout Duration",
    x = "Bout Duration (s)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins of 0.1 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

breaks <- c(seq(0, 15, by = 0.1), Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BORIS Freeze: Combining Approach Freeze and Being Approached Freeze
# ------------------------------------------------------------

boris_freeze <- boris_bouts %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      Behavior,
      regex("E-I-freez|I-E-freez", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = `Stop (s)` - `Start (s)`
  )

freeze_isolation <- boris_freeze %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

freeze_grouped <- boris_freeze %>%
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_freeze <- bind_rows(
  freeze_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  freeze_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      right = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    bout_bin_num = as.numeric(bout_bin) * 0.1 - 0.05,
    bout_bin_plot = compress_x(bout_bin_num)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  plot_freeze,
  aes(x = bout_bin_plot, fill = group)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    boundary = 0,
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped" = "black",
      "Isolation" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = compress_x(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15)),
    labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "5", "10", "15")
  ) +
  labs(

  )
```
```{r}
}
```

```{r}

simba_plot <- SimBA_sum %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(Video %in% isolation_list,
                   "Isolation",
                   "Grouped")
  )

simba_summary <- simba_plot %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bouts = mean(`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bouts = sd(`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# t-test
tt <- t.test(`Approach Social bouts` ~ Group, data = simba_plot)
pval <- tt$p.value

sig_label <- case_when(
  pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

y_max <- max(simba_plot$`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sig <- y_max * 1.10

ggplot() +

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = simba_summary,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      ymin = mean_bouts - sd_bouts,
      ymax = mean_bouts + sd_bouts
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines
  geom_segment(
    data = simba_summary,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(factor(Group)) - 0.20,
      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `Approach Social bouts`),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Isolation"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `Approach Social bouts`),
    shape = 21,
    color = "red",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Thick significance line
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = y_sig,
    yend = y_sig,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Red stars
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = y_sig + 0.03 * y_max,
    label = sig_label,
    color = "red",
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "IS13 SimBA Approach-Social (AS)",
    x = "",
    y = "Approach-Social Bouts (#)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
SimBA_sum <- read_excel(
  "Sum_1106.xlsx",
  sheet = "SimBA Summary"
)

Boris_sum <- read_excel(
  "Sum_1106.xlsx",
  sheet = "Boris Summary"
)
isolation_list = c("15_14_15", "14_45_07", "17_37_58", "16_40_59", "15_43_36", "17_08_59", "14_09_19", "14_39_00", "15_09_14", "15_23_34", "16_31_21", "16_58_53", "17_26_27")
sum_bouts = read_excel("sum_full3.xlsx")
boris_bouts = read_excel("boris_full3.xlsx")
sum_social = sum_bouts |>
  filter(behavior == "approach_social" | behavior == "nonapproach_social") |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)
sum_freeze = sum_bouts |>
  filter(behavior == "approach_freeze" | behavior == "nonapproach_freeze") |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)
social_isolation = sum_social |>
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)
social_grouped = sum_social |>
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)
freeze_isolation = sum_freeze |>
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)
freeze_grouped = sum_freeze |>
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins of 0.1 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

) %>%
```

```{r}
sum_bapproach_social <- sum_bouts |>
  filter(behavior == "nonapproach_social") |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)

sum_bapproach_freeze <- sum_bouts |>
  filter(
    behavior == "nonapproach_freeze" |
    behavior == "nonapproach_withdraw"
  ) |>
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)


social_isolation <- sum_bapproach_social %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

social_grouped <- sum_bapproach_social %>%
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_social <- bind_rows(
  social_isolation %>%
    mutate(group = "Isolation"),
  social_grouped %>%
    mutate(group = "Grouped")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bout_bin = cut(
      bout_time,
      breaks = breaks,
      right = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    bout_bin_num = as.numeric(bout_bin) * 0.1 - 0.05,
    bout_bin_plot = compress_x(bout_bin_num)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  plot_social,
  aes(x = bout_bin_plot, fill = group)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    boundary = 0,
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped" = "black",
      "Isolation" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = compress_x(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15)),
    labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "5", "10", "15")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IS14 SimBA Being Approached Social Bout Duration",
    x = "Bout Duration (s)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins of 0.1 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

breaks <- c(seq(0, 15, by = 0.1), Inf)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SimBA: Social and Freeze/Withdraw bouts
# ------------------------------------------------------------

simba_short <- sum_bouts %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = end_time - start_time,
    type = case_when(
      str_detect(behavior, regex("social", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Social",
      str_detect(behavior, regex("freeze|withdraw", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Freeze",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type), !is.na(bout_time), bout_time >= 0) %>%
  summarise(
    `Social <= 0.5s` = sum(type == "Social" & bout_time <= 0.5),
    `Social > 0.5s` = sum(type == "Social" & bout_time > 0.5),
    `Freeze <= 1s` = sum(type == "Freeze" & bout_time <= 1),
    `Freeze > 1s` = sum(type == "Freeze" & bout_time > 1)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Behavior",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Method = "SimBA")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BORIS: Social and Freeze/Withdraw bouts
# ------------------------------------------------------------

boris_short <- boris_bouts %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = `Stop (s)` - `Start (s)`,
    type = case_when(
      str_detect(
        Behavior,
        regex("E-I-social|I-E-social", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Social",
      str_detect(
        Behavior,
        regex("E-I-freez|I-E-freez", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Freeze",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type), !is.na(bout_time), bout_time >= 0) %>%
  summarise(
    `Social <= 0.5s` = sum(type == "Social" & bout_time <= 0.5),
    `Social > 0.5s` = sum(type == "Social" & bout_time > 0.5),
    `Freeze <= 1s` = sum(type == "Freeze" & bout_time <= 1),
    `Freeze > 1s` = sum(type == "Freeze" & bout_time > 1)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Behavior",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Method = "BORIS")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

short_bout_comparison <- bind_rows(
  simba_short,
  boris_short
) %>%
  mutate(
    Behavior = factor(
      Behavior,
      levels = c(
        "Social <= 0.5s",
        "Social > 0.5s",
        "Freeze <= 1s",
        "Freeze > 1s"
      )
    ),
    Method = factor(
      Method,
      levels = c("SimBA", "BORIS")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  short_bout_comparison,
  aes(
    x = Behavior,
    y = Count,
    fill = Method
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Count),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SimBA" = "black",
      "BORIS" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "SimBA vs BORIS: Bout Duration Comparison",
    x = "Behavior and Duration",
    y = "Total Number of Bouts",
    fill = "Scoring Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
```

```{r}

simba_plot <- SimBA_sum %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(Video %in% isolation_list,
                   "Isolation",
                   "Grouped")
  )

simba_summary <- simba_plot %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bouts = mean(`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bouts = sd(`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# t-test
tt <- t.test(`Approach Social bouts` ~ Group, data = simba_plot)
pval <- tt$p.value

sig_label <- case_when(
  pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

y_max <- max(simba_plot$`Approach Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sig <- y_max * 1.10

ggplot() +

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = simba_summary,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      ymin = mean_bouts - sd_bouts,
      ymax = mean_bouts + sd_bouts
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines
  geom_segment(
    data = simba_summary,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(factor(Group)) - 0.20,
      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `Approach Social bouts`),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Isolation"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `Approach Social bouts`),
    shape = 21,
    color = "red",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Thick significance line
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = y_sig,
    yend = y_sig,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Red stars
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = y_sig + 0.03 * y_max,
    label = sig_label,
    color = "red",
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "IS14 SimBA Approach-Social (AS)",
    x = "",
    y = "Approach-Social Bouts (#)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
)
```

```{r}
boris_plot <- Boris_sum %>%
```

```{r}
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# t-test
tt <- t.test(`BA Social bouts` ~ Group, data = boris_plot)

  pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

y_max <- max(boris_plot$`BA Social bouts`, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sig <- y_max * 1.10

ggplot() +

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = boris_summary,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      ymin = mean_bouts - sd_bouts,
      ymax = mean_bouts + sd_bouts
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines
  geom_segment(
    data = boris_summary,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(factor(Group)) - 0.20,
      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(boris_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = `BA Social bouts`),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(boris_plot, Group == "Isolation"),

    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Red significance stars
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = y_sig + 0.03 * y_max,
    label = sig_label,
    color = "red",
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
```

```{r}
# Calculate ratio once
simba_plot <- SimBA_sum %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(Video %in% isolation_list,
                   "Isolation",
                   "Grouped"),
    ratio = (`Approach Social bouts` - `Approach Freeze bouts`) /
            (`Approach Social bouts` + `Approach Freeze bouts`)
  )

ratio_summary <- simba_plot %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bouts = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bouts = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# t-test
tt <- t.test(ratio ~ Group, data = simba_plot)
pval <- tt$p.value

sig_label <- case_when(
  pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
  pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
  pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE         ~ ""
)

y_max <- max(simba_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sig <- y_max + 0.15 * diff(range(simba_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot() +

  # SD error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = ratio_summary,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      ymin = mean_bouts - sd_bouts,
      ymax = mean_bouts + sd_bouts
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Mean horizontal lines
  geom_segment(
    data = ratio_summary,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(factor(Group)) - 0.20,
      xend = as.numeric(factor(Group)) + 0.20,
      y = mean_bouts,
      yend = mean_bouts
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Grouped points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Grouped"),
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio),
    shape = 24,
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Isolation points
  geom_point(
    data = subset(simba_plot, Group == "Isolation"),
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio),
    shape = 21,
    color = "red",
    fill = NA,
    stroke = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +

  # Thick significance line
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = y_sig,
    yend = y_sig,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Red significance stars
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = y_sig + 0.05 * diff(range(simba_plot$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    label = sig_label,
    color = "red",
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "IS14 SimBA (AS-AF)/(AS+AF) Index",
    x = "",
    y = "AS-AF Conflict Index"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
)
```

```{r}
library(tibble)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Video sex mapping
# ------------------------------------------------------------

video_sex <- tribble(
  ~Video,     ~Sex,
  "14_30_35", "female",
  "14_45_07", "female",
  "14_59_45", "female",
  "15_14_15", "male",
  "15_28_56", "female",
  "15_43_36", "male",
  "16_27_03", "female",
  "16_40_59", "male",
  "16_54_42", "male",
  "17_08_59", "male",
  "17_23_03", "male",
  "17_37_58", "male",
  "13_54_20", "female",
  "14_09_19", "female",
  "14_23_37", "female",
  "14_39_00", "female",
  "14_54_38", "female",
  "15_09_14", "female",
  "15_23_34", "female",
  "16_17_56", "male",
  "16_31_21", "male",
  "16_45_16", "male",
  "16_58_53", "male",
  "17_12_56", "male",
  "17_26_27", "male",
  "13_36_50", "female",
  "13_51_56", "female",
  "14_08_30", "male",
  "14_23_28", "male",
  "13_54_29", "female",
  "14_25_44", "male",
  "14_10_39", "male"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(
    x <= cutoff,
    x,
    cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Histogram bins of 0.1 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

breaks <- c(seq(0, 15, by = 0.1), Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Assign four categories
# ------------------------------------------------------------

classify_videos <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    left_join(video_sex, by = c("video_name" = "Video")) %>%
    mutate(
      group = case_when(
        Sex == "male" & video_name %in% isolation_list ~ "Male-Isolation",
        Sex == "male" & !video_name %in% isolation_list ~ "Male-Grouped",
        Sex == "female" & video_name %in% isolation_list ~ "Female-Isolation",
        Sex == "female" & !video_name %in% isolation_list ~ "Female-Grouped",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      group = factor(
        group,
        levels = c(
          "Male-Grouped",
          "Male-Isolation",
          "Female-Grouped",
          "Female-Isolation"
        )
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary function: average bout length and count per video
# ------------------------------------------------------------

summarize_bouts <- function(data, behavior_name) {

  # First calculate statistics for each video
  video_summary <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(Sex)) %>%
    group_by(Sex, video_name) %>%
    summarise(
      avg_bout_length = mean(bout_time, na.rm = TRUE),
      bout_count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Then average across videos within each sex
  video_summary %>%
    group_by(Sex) %>%
    summarise(
      avg_bout_length = mean(avg_bout_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_bout_count = mean(bout_count, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_videos = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Behavior = behavior_name)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare data for each condition
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Grouped Social
grouped_social <- boris_social %>%
  filter(!video_name %in% isolation_list)

# Isolation Social
isolation_social <- boris_social %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

# Isolation Freeze
isolation_freeze <- boris_freeze %>%
  filter(video_name %in% isolation_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine summaries
# ------------------------------------------------------------

summary_by_sex <- bind_rows(
  summarize_bouts(grouped_social, "Grouped Social"),
  summarize_bouts(isolation_social, "Isolation Social"),
  summarize_bouts(isolation_freeze, "Isolation Freeze")
) %>%
  select(
    Sex,
    Behavior,
    n_videos,
    avg_bout_length,
    avg_bout_count
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(Sex, levels = c("male", "female")),
    factor(
      Behavior,
      levels = c(
        "Grouped Social",
        "Isolation Social",
        "Isolation Freeze"
      )
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Display summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

summary_by_sex
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compress x-axis after 3 seconds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compress_x <- function(x, cutoff = 3, compression = 0.15) {
  ifelse(x <= cutoff, x, cutoff + (x - cutoff) * compression)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare SimBA data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

simba_social <- sum_bouts %>%
  filter(str_detect(behavior, regex("social", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)

simba_freeze <- sum_bouts %>%
  filter(str_detect(behavior, regex("freeze|withdraw", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(bout_time = end_time - start_time)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot function
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_simba_distribution <- function(data, title) {

  # Include all videos, including those with zero bouts
  video_info <- video_sex %>%
    transmute(
      video_name = Video,
      Sex = factor(str_to_title(Sex), levels = c("Male", "Female")),
      group = ifelse(
        Video %in% isolation_list,
        "Isolation",
        "Grouped"
      ),
      group = factor(group, levels = c("Grouped", "Isolation"))
    )

  # Number of videos in each group and sex
  video_counts <- video_info %>%
    count(group, Sex, name = "n_videos")

  # Count bouts in each original 0.1-second bin
  plot_data <- data %>%
    inner_join(video_info, by = "video_name") %>%
    filter(is.finite(bout_time), bout_time >= 0, bout_time < 15) %>%
    mutate(bin = floor(bout_time / 0.1)) %>%
    count(group, Sex, bin, name = "n") %>%
    complete(
      nesting(group, Sex),
      bin = 0:149,
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    left_join(video_counts, by = c("group", "Sex")) %>%
    mutate(
      bouts_per_video = n / n_videos,
      xmin = bin * 0.1,
      xmax = xmin + 0.1,
      xmin_plot = compress_x(xmin),
      xmax_plot = compress_x(xmax),
      region = ifelse(xmin >= 3, "Tail", "Main")
    )

  ggplot(plot_data) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = xmin_plot,
        xmax = xmax_plot,
        ymin = 0,
        ymax = bouts_per_video,
        fill = group,
        alpha = region
      ),
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.1
    ) +
    facet_grid(group ~ Sex) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Grouped" = "black",
        "Isolation" = "red"
      )
    ) +
    scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c("Main" = 1, "Tail" = 0.3),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = compress_x(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15)),
      labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "5", "10", "15"),
      limits = c(0, compress_x(15)),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Bout Duration (s)",
      y = "Bouts per Video"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 13, face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        size = 11, color = "black"
      ),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 12, face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.8, "lines")
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot SimBA Social and Freeze
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_simba_social <- plot_simba_distribution(
  simba_social,
  "IS14 SimBA Social Bout Duration"
)

p_simba_freeze <- plot_simba_distribution(
  simba_freeze,
  "IS14 SimBA Freeze/Withdrawal Bout Duration"
)

print(p_simba_social)
print(p_simba_freeze)
```
